## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update dependency vite to v8.3.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/502
* feat(ui): add an Allow All switch to the Workbench AI assistant by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/500
* fix(events): skip already-stored GitHub events before normalizing or backfilling by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/503
* fix(workbench): validate MCP tool arguments before calling the Axiom API by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/504
* chore(deps): update dependency python to v3.15.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/507
* chore(deps): update dependency node to v24.22.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/506
* chore(deps): update actions/setup-python digest to 6d4fd22 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/508
* feat(events): JSON Schemas for every event type with runtime validation by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/514
* feat(agents): pass configured plugin dirs to the claude-code CLI so skills load under --bare by @paoloantinori in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/510
* fix(deps): update dependency @apitomy/flow-ui to ^3.0.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/516
* fix(assistant): avoid database access during shutdown when destroying sessions by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/518
* fix(workbench): ignore out-of-order subscription preview responses by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/505
* fix(deps): update dependency io.apitomy:apitomy-flow-engine to v3.0.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/521
* fix(app): replace the removed Glob and Grep tool names with Bash patterns by @paoloantinori in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/520
* fix(jira): accurate Jira events — issue state as of each event, new event types, config hardening by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/519
* feat(ui): schema-driven EL field reference and validation warnings by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/522

* fix(deps): update dependency victory-zoom-container to v37.4.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/557
* fix(workflow): expose joinArrivals and history branchId to run viewer (#513) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/558
* fix(assistant): record session usage after each turn (#517) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/559
* feat(agents): record the model that actually ran on agent tasks (#524) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/561
* fix(opencode): run sessions in task workspace and surface failures (#523) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/560
* ShellContext: a quote inside a comment no longer quotes the rest of the template by @paoloantinori in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/538
* feat(ui): show AI session cost and model in the Workbench chat pane by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/564
* feat(workbench): remove individual test runs and clear all by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/563
* feat(workbench): let the user send a test run's results to the AI by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/562
* feat(workbench): running a suggested test replaces the suggestion in place by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/565
* fix(workflow): extract agent JSON output robustly when prose contains braces by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/566
* fix(deps): update dependency react-router-dom to v7.18.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/567
* fix: address QA findings from post-3.0.0 manual testing by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/573
* fix(deps): update dependency elkjs to v0.12.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/574
* feat(ui): show AI session details as a striped, header-less table by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/575

## New Contributors
* @paoloantinori made their first contribution in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/510
